propositions: Mode inherits str and functools.total_ordering does not override inherited string comparison methods, causing __gt__ and related operators to use lexical ordering instead of rank-based ordering.
Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE > Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK evaluates to false due to lexical comparison, breaking check_phase_gate logic that should block higher modes when the stored gate is reconcile-check.

Rich comparison operators (__lt__, __le__, __gt__, __ge__) must be explicitly defined on Mode to enforce the correct rank order: reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live.
The fix must preserve Mode enum values, equality semantics, MODE_CAPS, from_str behavior, and persisted gate strings without requiring data migration.
